facts.value: ASU may offer conditional undergraduate admission to international applicants to an on-campus program who meet the academic (aptitude) and competency requirements, but are not proficient in English.
Conditional admission allows time to improve English proficiency before starting classes at ASU.
The conditional admission offer is good for up to three semesters.
You must meet one of the English proficiency requirements to begin your ASU experience.
Arizona State University recognizes that educational systems are different across the world.
To help determine if academic credentials are comparable to a U.S. high school degree, review the requirements for the country from which your credential was earned.
